This role is based onsite to support the high security requirements of our clients and enable effective collaboration. We have a welcoming office environment, fully stocked with snacks, regular team outings (summer boat cruise, escape room, etc.), and a strong focus on maintaining a healthy work-life balance while doing meaningful, impactful work together.

descriptionPlain:
About the Job & Shakudo

At Shakudo, we are building the world’s first operating system for data and AI. We use the term operating system in the truest sense of the word. Like iOS, Windows and Linux, Shakudo’s end-to-end OS offers ever-evolving, automatically operated, best-of-breed open-source components tailored to each business's unique needs.

As we continue to grow, we're in search of exceptional Business Development Representatives (BDR), tasked with leading our outbound efforts in our target industries. As a BDR, your role will be pivotal in how Shakudo grows market presence in mid-market businesses and enterprises, generates solution-oriented opportunities, and increases the number of companies that build data products on Shakudo.
 
You’re someone who has experience in selling Data/AI/ML infrastructure, IT solutions, system integration, or digital consulting—and you enjoy engaging deeply with CIOs, CTOs, VPs, Directors, and other tech leaders.
 
Why this role?
Shakudo is growing quickly, and we’re looking to expand our go to market efforts in business development. We have strong product market fit with our customers, and want to scale out our awareness with targeted outbound activity.
 
There is no shortage of BDR roles on the market, so we wanted to share why ours is unique:
Fast track to AE: Ideal candidates will be mentored into the role within 12 months.
Engage with buyers on some of the most innovative data products in the market.

At Shakudo, we are building the world’s first operating system for data and AI. We use the term operating system in the truest sense of the word. Like iOS, Windows and Linux, Shakudo’s end-to-end OS offers ever-evolving, automatically operated, best-of-breed open-source components tailored to each business's unique needs.

As we scale our go-to-market, we’re looking for a Channel BDR to build and grow our partner channel from the ground up. This is a unique BDR-adjacent role where your primary mission is outbound—finding, engaging, and signing up independent consultants and advisors who work with CIOs, CTOs, VPs, and other technology leaders at large enterprises.

Think of it as sales meets ecosystem building: you’ll be the person who goes out and recruits the consultants who already have the ear of the tech executives we want to reach. Each consultant you sign up becomes a Shakudo partner, leveraging their existing relationships to open doors and generate qualified meetings. The more partners you recruit and the more results they drive, the more you succeed.

Why this role?
Shakudo has strong product-market fit, and our customers are building some of the most innovative data products in the market. We want to amplify our reach through a partner channel—and we need someone who thrives on high-volume outreach to build it.

This isn’t your typical BDR role:
Directly shape a new channel: You’ll be the first dedicated hire building Shakudo’s consultant partner network.
High-volume, high-impact outbound: You’ll make a lot of calls and send a lot of messages—and every partner you sign up compounds your impact.
Fast track to channel leadership: Prove the model and grow into a leadership role managing the partner ecosystem.


Shakudo offers a high-impact package: competitive salary, meaningful equity so you share in the upside of transformational technology, and comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage. More importantly, you'll work on technology that matters.

This role is based onsite to support the high security requirements of our clients and enable effective collaboration. Our culture is intense, focused, and fast-paced—we move quickly and hold ourselves to a high bar. We expect high ownership: you will be hands-on, driving outcomes directly rather than delegating or waiting for direction. Individual contribution matters here—your work will have a visible, measurable impact on the company’s growth. We have a welcoming office environment, fully stocked with snacks, regular team outings, and a team that is deeply driven by the work we do together.

Shakudo is an equal opportunity employer and encourages candidates of all backgrounds to apply. We foster diversity and inclusivity and welcome applications from a broad range of backgrounds and experiences.

• Own the full cycle of partner recruitment: identify, outreach, qualify, and sign up independent consultants and advisors as Shakudo channel partners.
  • Execute high-volume outbound (calls, emails, LinkedIn) to find consultants who advise technology executives at mid-market and enterprise companies.
  • Educate prospective partners on the Shakudo value proposition and the mutual benefits of the partnership program—including contingency-based bonuses tied to the meetings and deals they generate.

  • Experience working with or selling to consultants, advisors, system integrators, or channel partners is a strong plus
  • Familiarity with data/AI/ML infrastructure, IT solutions, or enterprise technology sales
  • Excellent communication skills—ability to quickly articulate value and build trust with experienced professionals
  • Highly organized; proficient with CRM (Hubspot), LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Slack, and GSuite
  • Curious and resourceful—able to research industries and identify the right consultants to approach

As our OS Platform General Manager, you'll lead the core business unit representing Shakudo's primary value proposition - the Data & AI Operating System itself. - Continuous innovation balanced with enterprise stability and reliability
- Long-term thinking about platform evolution and market leadership

At Shakudo, we're building the world's first operating system for data and AI. We use the term "operating system" in the truest sense: just like iOS, Windows, or Linux, Shakudo's end-to-end OS provides ever-evolving, fully automated, best-in-class open-source components tailored to each business's unique needs.
 
We are seeking an Infrastructure Engineer to join our Business Automation team to own and operate the internal systems, infrastructure, and AI Gateway product that power Shakudo at scale. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives on keeping production systems reliable, secure, and fast. You will be responsible for everything from physical servers and DGX machines to CI/CD pipelines and customer-facing AI Gateway infrastructure. You will also contribute directly to product hardening, security, and DevOps practices across the platform.
 
At Shakudo, our culture is proactive, collaborative, and supportive — we succeed together by building strong partnerships and solving complex challenges. We expect high ownership: you will be hands-on, driving outcomes directly rather than delegating or waiting for direction. Individual contribution matters here — your work will have a visible, measurable impact on the company's operations and product.

We use the term "operating system" in the truest sense: just like iOS, Windows, or Linux, Shakudo's end-to-end OS provides ever-evolving, fully automated, best-in-class open-source components tailored to each business's unique needs.
 
We are seeking an Infrastructure Engineer to join our Business Automation team to own and operate the internal systems, infrastructure, and AI Gateway product that power Shakudo at scale. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives on keeping production systems reliable, secure, and fast. You will be responsible for everything from physical servers and DGX machines to CI/CD pipelines and customer-facing AI Gateway infrastructure. You will also contribute directly to product hardening, security, and DevOps practices across the platform.
 
At Shakudo, our culture is proactive, collaborative, and supportive — we succeed together by building strong partnerships and solving complex challenges. We expect high ownership: you will be hands-on, driving outcomes directly rather than delegating or waiting for direction. Individual contribution matters here — your work will have a visible, measurable impact on the company's operations and product.

lists.content:
• Maintain and operate internal services for the rest of the Shakudo employees, including proprietary applications for sales and ETL pipelines
  • Maintain and operate DGX machines that host LLMs for the team's use
  • Maintain and operate Shakudo's product for Shakudo's internal use, and contribute to product hardening, security, and DevOps practices
  • Maintain and operate physical servers for Kubernetes clusters and ensure uptime
  • Create CI/CD pipelines for internal deployments
  • Maintain and operate the AI Gateway product for customers, ensure uptime, and contribute to product roadmap

• 8+ years of experience across software, data, platform, or AI engineering roles
  • 5+ years of strong experience with Kubernetes cluster operation and DevOps, and bare-metal server operations
  • Experience operating production infrastructure at scale, including physical servers, GPU clusters, and CI/CD systems
  • Strong background in security hardening, observability, and reliability engineering
  • Proficiency in Rust is preferred
  • Experience with AI/ML infrastructure, including LLM hosting and inference serving is preferred

Work with cutting-edge technologies in machine learning and high-performance computing. Contribute to a platform that transforms how organizations leverage data and AI. Join a dynamic team that values innovation, efficiency, and diversity.
 
Shakudo offers a high-impact package: competitive salary, meaningful equity so you share in the upside of transformational technology, and comprehensive health benefits that have you fully covered. We provide a flexible vacation policy—because building transformational technology requires supporting the people who build it. More importantly, you'll work on technology that matters.
 
This role is based onsite in Toronto to support the high security requirements of our clients and enable effective collaboration. We have a welcoming office environment with a very focused and passionate team, doing meaningful, impactful work together.
 
Shakudo is an equal opportunity employer and encourages candidates of all backgrounds to apply. We foster diversity and inclusivity and welcome applications from a broad range of backgrounds and experiences.

descriptionPlain:
What is Shakudo?
The name is the Japanese word for alloy—different metals combined into something new. That's exactly what we're doing at Shakudo.
 
We're building the world's first OS for data and AI—an ecosystem that empowers software engineers to build sophisticated data and AI applications without becoming infrastructure experts. We use "operating system" in the truest product sense: like iOS, Windows, or Linux, Shakudo provides an end‑to‑end, ever‑evolving, automatically operated stack of best‑of‑breed open‑source components, applications and integrations tailored to each business's needs.
 
Which segment of the market do we serve?
As a startup, this evolves. Today, we serve large enterprises—often in air‑gapped data centers and complex deployment environments where failure isn't an option. It's one of our biggest value props and presents unique technical and product challenges. If you thrive in ambiguity and enjoy making the unknown known while solving problems that matter, you'll fit right in.
 
The role
We are looking for passionate engineers who have extensive experience operating Kubernetes, building Kubernetes controllers, and control flow design and implementation.
 
You'll lead and own complex platform features and enterprise customer implementations end‑to‑end—from architecture and development to deployment strategy and customer success. Your technical decisions directly impact how enterprise-scale organizations operate. You'll work on a platform with stakeholders from technical teams to C-suite executives, driving high-stakes projects with autonomy and self-direction while mentoring junior engineers. As a startup, you'll have significant influence on technical direction and team culture.
We're an onsite team. Join us in the office for fast feedback loops, and shipping together at high velocity.
 
The ideal candidate
We're an engineering‑first organization focused on solving the hardest problems in enterprise data and AI. We eat, breathe, and sleep the latest in systems engineering and customer delivery, adopting new tech when it's battle‑tested (half a step behind the bleeding edge). If you're excited about technical leadership that creates real-world impact and working on technology that transforms industries, you'll fit right in. We value high productivity, customer obsession, technical excellence, self-sufficiency, and autonomy without the ego.
 
What's the stack?
Multi-tenant platform components run on Kubernetes with React/TypeScript frontends and TypeScript backends. Enterprise deployments leverage our advanced DevOps automation built on Kubernetes, Helm, and Terraform, with sophisticated implementations for enterprise security, compliance, and air-gapped environments where security and reliability are paramount.
We believe in picking the right tool for the job. If another technology is a better fit for solving a customer's critical problem, we'll use it.
 
Examples of what we build
Enterprise-scale platform architectures that become the data backbone for Fortune 500 companies
Advanced deployment automation for the most secure and regulated environments
Complex customer integration systems that transform how organizations operate
 
You'll lead these initiatives from vision to reality, working directly with executive stakeholders to drive transformational outcomes.
 
Office Location
We have a strong 5 days a week onsite company culture, both to learn from others and to share experiences among the team. Our office is in Menlo Park, just off the 101.

We're building the world's first OS for data and AI—an ecosystem that empowers software engineers to build sophisticated data and AI applications without becoming infrastructure experts. We use "operating system" in the truest product sense: like iOS, Windows, or Linux, Shakudo provides an end‑to‑end, ever‑evolving, automatically operated stack of best‑of‑breed open‑source components, applications and integrations tailored to each business's needs.
 
Which segment of the market do we serve?
As a startup, this evolves. Today, we serve large enterprises—often in air‑gapped data centers and complex deployment environments where failure isn't an option. It's one of our biggest value props and presents unique technical and product challenges. If you thrive in ambiguity and enjoy making the unknown known while solving problems that matter, you'll fit right in.
 
The role
We are looking for passionate engineers who have extensive experience operating Kubernetes, building Kubernetes controllers, and control flow design and implementation.
 
You'll lead and own complex platform features and enterprise customer implementations end‑to‑end—from architecture and development to deployment strategy and customer success. Your technical decisions directly impact how enterprise-scale organizations operate. You'll work on a platform with stakeholders from technical teams to C-suite executives, driving high-stakes projects with autonomy and self-direction while mentoring junior engineers. As a startup, you'll have significant influence on technical direction and team culture.
We're an onsite team. Join us in the office for fast feedback loops, and shipping together at high velocity.
 
The ideal candidate
We're an engineering‑first organization focused on solving the hardest problems in enterprise data and AI. We eat, breathe, and sleep the latest in systems engineering and customer delivery, adopting new tech when it's battle‑tested (half a step behind the bleeding edge). If you're excited about technical leadership that creates real-world impact and working on technology that transforms industries, you'll fit right in. We value high productivity, customer obsession, technical excellence, self-sufficiency, and autonomy without the ego.
 
What's the stack?
Multi-tenant platform components run on Kubernetes with React/TypeScript frontends and TypeScript backends. Enterprise deployments leverage our advanced DevOps automation built on Kubernetes, Helm, and Terraform, with sophisticated implementations for enterprise security, compliance, and air-gapped environments where security and reliability are paramount.
We believe in picking the right tool for the job. If another technology is a better fit for solving a customer's critical problem, we'll use it.
 
Examples of what we build
Enterprise-scale platform architectures that become the data backbone for Fortune 500 companies
Advanced deployment automation for the most secure and regulated environments
Complex customer integration systems that transform how organizations operate
 
You'll lead these initiatives from vision to reality, working directly with executive stakeholders to drive transformational outcomes.
 
Office Location
We have a strong 5 days a week onsite company culture, both to learn from others and to share experiences among the team. Our office is in Menlo Park, just off the 101.

lists.content:
• Design and deliver end-to-end technical solutions on the Shakudo platform that address real-world data and AI challenges for enterprise customers
  • Integrate open-source and proprietary components seamlessly with the Shakudo platform using Kubernetes, Helm Charts, and infrastructure-as-code
  • Build elegant, production-ready solutions — not just proof-of-concepts — that customers rely on in production
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and establish design patterns for platform development with high autonomy
  • Serve as the trusted technical advisor for assigned accounts — understand their infrastructure, roadmap, and pain points deeply
  • Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues customers face in their data and AI stack, from Kubernetes orchestration to pipeline performance
  • Identify opportunities to expand Shakudo's footprint within existing accounts by connecting customer needs to platform capabilities
  • Navigate customer organizations effectively — from individual contributors to engineering leaders and C-suite decision-makers
  • Champion customer needs internally, influencing product direction and Stack team priorities
  • Partner with Product and Engineering teams to translate customer requirements into scalable, robust systems
  • Collaborate with Customer Engineering to ensure smooth hand-offs and consistent solution quality
  • Contribute to internal knowledge bases, solution patterns, and best practices that accelerate delivery across the team

• 4–8 years of experience in solution engineering, solution architecture, or a senior engineering role with significant client-facing responsibility
  • Strong Kubernetes and Helm Chart development and deployment experience
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure as code
  • Backend and frontend experience (e.g., Python, React, TypeScript) — enough to be hands-on when needed
  • Demonstrated ability to manage client relationships, solve complex technical problems under pressure, and drive account growth
  • Excellent communication skills — you can explain deep technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and translate business requirements into architecture
  • A hands-on, solutions-first mindset and a passion for fast, high-quality delivery

• Experience in data engineering, MLOps, or AI infrastructure
  • Prior experience in a Solutions Architect or Solutions Engineer role at a B2B infrastructure or platform company
  • Familiarity with the open-source data and AI ecosystem (dbt, Airflow, MLflow, etc.)
